name: font_reload_cache_acquire

ownership.argument: Lookup-only acquire: calls cache class+12 when cache count is nonzero and increments returned entry through 0x0c908f4c. Returned entry is a held reference requiring cache release; never assume it is newly created.
ownership.return_value: See restricted adapter use contract; no general public callable approval.

notes: Lookup-only acquire: calls cache class+12 when cache count is nonzero and increments returned entry through 0x0c908f4c.
